canonical_form: UTF-8 bytes; every string Unicode NFC; CRLF and CR converted to LF; no other whitespace change inside strings
file = one JSON array of objects, sorted by question_id (string ascending) before hashing; array order inside an object is kept as authored
serialization = json.dumps(items, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); no trailing newline
hash = SHA-256 of those bytes, lowercase hex
questions and answers are two separate files and two separate hashes; neither file may contain the other's fields
